project_supplier.referenceDomain: forall m, physicalPieceOpen S K (C.referenceState,0) m = referencePhysicalPieceOpen S K m
project_supplier.partition: forall z in stateNeighborhood S C base epsilon, stateSector S z.1 -> exists E : Set PolarPoint, volume E = 0 and forall p in annularOpen D minus E, exists unique m with p in physicalPieceOpen S K z m

actual_inputs: The same CanonicalGeometry certificate hgeom, with actual reference-state neighborhood membership hrefmem and sector membership hsref.
f,g : PolarPoint -> Real continuous on annularOpen D, supplied from their actual definitions.
For every actual referencePhysicalPieceOpen S K m, the already proved pointwise inequality f<=g on that piece.
sequence: Apply hgeom.partition (C.referenceState,0) hrefmem hsref to get the actual two-dimensional null set E and cover. No separate one-dimensional partition construction is needed.
Use MeasureTheory.measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hE to obtain forall-a.e. p with respect to global volume, p notin E. E need not be measurable.
Transport this event by MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_ae to volume.restrict (annularOpen D). Intersect with MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem hU.measurableSet, where hU is the actual open annular product.
For an actual p in the intersection, obtain m from the cover and rewrite its membership using hgeom.referenceDomain m. Apply the real piece inequality, then min_eq_left, to prove min(f p)(g p)=f p.
Obtain ContinuousOn (fun p => min(f p)(g p)) U pointwise by Filter.Tendsto.min (hf p hp) (hg p hp). This is the generated to_dual counterpart of the exact pinned Filter.Tendsto.max theorem.
Apply MeasureTheory.Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq with mu := (volume : Measure PolarPoint), the restricted a.e. equality, open U, and the two ContinuousOn proofs.
For p in U, conclude f p<=g p by (heq p hp).symm.trans_le (min_le_right _ _). This avoids any iff-name ambiguity.

exact_api.extension: MeasureTheory.Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq {f g : X -> Y} (h : f =ae[mu.restrict U] g) (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : ContinuousOn f U) (hg : ContinuousOn g U) : EqOn f g U
exact_api.extension_context: TopologicalSpace X; MeasurableSpace X; TopologicalSpace Y; T2Space Y; IsOpenPosMeasure mu. The mu parameter is implicit at the theorem and may be passed explicitly by name.
exact_api.null_event: MeasureTheory.measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem : mu s = 0 <-> forall-a.e. a with respect to mu, a notin s
exact_api.restriction: MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_ae {s} {p} (h : forall-a.e. x with respect to mu, p x) : forall-a.e. x with respect to mu.restrict s, p x
exact_api.restricted_membership: MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem (hs : MeasurableSet s) : forall-a.e. x with respect to mu.restrict s, x in s
exact_api.continuous_min: Filter.Tendsto.min, generated from the to_dual max declaration in pinned OrderClosed.lean
exact_api.inequality_to_equality: min_eq_left (h : a<=b) : min a b = a
exact_api.equality_to_inequality: min_eq_left_iff.mp is the iff API if desired; alternatively use equality.symm.trans_le (min_le_right _ _).

important_corrections: The pinned null-set theorem is measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem, not ae_not_mem.
min_eq_left is an implication from an inequality, not an iff supporting .mp.
Pass global volume to eqOn_open_of_ae_eq. The theorem itself restricts the measure to U; do not request global IsOpenPosMeasure of volume.restrict U.
Use the pointwise Filter.Tendsto.min proof for ContinuousOn; no unverified ContinuousOn.min overload is required.

Reference-state helper theorems are not all available from the proposed three imports: reference_mem_stateNeighborhood is in Analysis.StateNeighborhood, while referenceStateConditions.stateSector is in Analysis.SolveReturnEquations, which imports Blueprint.Statements. To keep a future leaf independent of Blueprint, take these actual membership facts explicitly or supply them upstream.
No moving-domain equality, replacement sample, or global inequality premise is introduced. The current state may be fixed in f; the cover used in this argument remains the actual reference partition.
The route does not supply continuity of an arbitrary piecewise sample envelope. The actual f and g must have the stated global-on-annulus continuity from independent providers.

measure_instance_evidence.type: PolarPoint is the ordinary product Real x Real; use its product-volume instance, not an assumed inner-product structure for the product norm.
measure_instance_evidence.chain: Lebesgue.Basic -> Haar.OfBasis -> Haar.Basic -> Group.Prod -> Group.Measure -> Measure.Prod
measure_instance_evidence.real: Real volume has the additive Haar instance, whose parents include IsOpenPosMeasure; it is SFinite.
measure_instance_evidence.product: Measure.Prod explicitly provides prod.instIsOpenPosMeasure and the instance for volume on X x Y, given the component open-positive volumes and SFinite volume on Y.
